seal.statement: A preserved branch has never been proven and nothing tells its author. Since the non-main preservation fast path landed (79e8c7cb9 + 4c98b0a59, 2026-10-02/03) a git push of only non-main branch refs skips the local gate, and ci.yml runs only on pushes to main and on pull requests into main, so the branch's change cone runs nowhere: origin/quest/0-3-queryable-core-foundation carried a red hook test and a stage manifest that did not match the hook, its four stacked PRs (#88, #91, #95, #96, three of them with review/ heads) and the conflicting PR #74 got no CI, and a red direct commit sat on a landing branch until the publish gate caught it. The owner's decision (2026-10-04) is to run the CI change gate on quest/** and land/** pushes on self-hosted lab runners; measured on 2026-10-04 that path is not usable (the only runner registered to psvensson/lagrange is the offline GCP proof VM, no lab host is registered to any repository, the documented private control repository does not exist, and the repository is public), so this quest implements the owner's stated fallback and does not route the gate to GitHub-hosted runners: the fast path prints exactly one line saying the push is unproven, that the change gate (ci.yml) runs only on main and pull requests into main, and the command that proves the first pushed commit's cone (node scripts/lab.js test changed --lane all --split --sha <sha>, or a push with LAGRANGE_PUSH_PROVE_BRANCH=1). The line is not printed for a main push, for LAGRANGE_PUSH_PROVE_BRANCH=1, or for a deletion-only push, and its CI claim is bound to ci.yml's own triggers by a witness so it cannot outlive a change to them.

text: Self-hosted state measured 2026-10-04 (read-only). (1) gh api repos/psvensson/lagrange/actions/runners: total_count 1 - lagrange-gcp-runner, labels self-hosted/Linux/X64/gcp, status offline (the GCP proof VM lagrange-ci-runner, woken only by the wake jobs of full-gate.yml and formation-health.yml through GCP WIF; formation-health's health job ran on it today, run 37177562826). (2) No lab host is registered anywhere: node scripts/lab.js runner labels tv-dator|main-linux|lenovo-laptop|adam-laptop print only computed labels (home,lagrange,linux,x64,role-runner,...), and the private control repository docs/development/home-lab.md prescribes (psvensson/lagrange-lab) does not exist (gh api repos/psvensson/lagrange-lab -> 404); node scripts/lab.js fleet shows 7 hosts ready and free for lab test, not as Actions runners. (3) Routing mechanism: ci.yml gate runs-on = push && head_commit.message contains '[ci:self-hosted]' ? 'self-hosted' : 'ubuntu-24.04'; the publisher (scripts/publish-head.js resolvePublishRunner, SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_MARKER) requires the marker in the reviewed head AND --runner self-hosted, authorized by scripts/action-authority.js ROUTE_SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER; no input and no repository variable (the only variable is DOCKERHUB_USERNAME). The 'self-hosted' label matches only the GCP VM and ci.yml has no wake job, so a marked push would queue on an offline runner; no commit on any ref carries the marker except aafce1ba6 and 2b64c156b, which describe it. (4) gh api repos/psvensson/lagrange: visibility public; actions/permissions/fork-pr-contributor-approval: approval_policy first_time_contributors. Conclusion: the owner's self-hosted (lab) path is not usable today; the stated fallback is implemented and the CI change is not made (never routed to GitHub-hosted).

Design and security reasoning. A pull_request run uses the PR's own copy of ci.yml, so a fork PR can rewrite runs-on to [self-hosted]; on this public repository with approval_policy first_time_contributors, any contributor with one merged PR can reach every runner registered to the repository without an approval click. Trigger design (push-only routing, never pull_request) therefore cannot keep fork code off a lab host registered here - the protection must be where the runner is registered, which is why home-lab.md already forbids attaching home machines to this repository. The same exposure applies today to the GCP VM while it is awake (recorded for the owner; changing the approval policy or runner registration is an R26 action not taken). Requirements before the CI path can be enabled: (a) lab runners registered to the private control repository (or this repository's approval policy raised to all outside collaborators AND a lab-only label, an owner decision), with a dispatch from quest/** and land/** pushes and a status written back to the head sha (a new cross-repository token/secret); (b) the job must enter the lab's machine-wide lock: npm run check does not take it (only scripts/lab/probe.js and harness.js do), while thermal is gated per batch by run-classified-test-files; so the job should run node scripts/lab.js test changed on its own host rather than npm run check, or the lock recipe; (c) the proof base must be the merge-base with main: ci.yml's push range is github.event.before..HEAD and a new branch (before = zero sha) falls back to HEAD^, i.e. it would prove only the tip; (d) concurrency must cancel superseded non-main pushes (today cancel-in-progress is pull_request only, to keep main's exact-sha proofs); (e) stacked PR heads are mostly review/** (#88, #95, #96; #91 is quest/**), so a quest/** + land/** push trigger alone would not cover them. Alternative not taken: route quest/** and land/** to the GCP VM with a wake job - not lab, costs per push, needs id-token: write in ci.yml and a WIF attribute condition admitting non-main refs (unread), owner decision.

History pass. 79e8c7cb9 (2026-10-02, cherry-pick of #71 95ad919cc) added the non-main preservation fast path to .githooks/pre-push; 4c98b0a59 (2026-10-03) declared branch-preservation-fast-path in test/manifests/pre-push-stages.json. ci.yml has run on push [main] + pull_request [main] since the 2026-07-26 GitHub cutover (4dfea70cb); aafce1ba6 (2026-08-06) added the '[ci:self-hosted]' head-commit routing and 2b64c156b (2026-08-19) made the gate npm run check. From 2026-10-02 a non-main push therefore had no proof anywhere unless it became a PR into main: the incident shapes in the statement (quest/0-3-queryable-core-foundation red hook test + stale stage manifest; stacked PRs #88/#91/#95/#96 into it and #74 with zero checks) follow directly. The old fast path already printed 'set LAGRANGE_PUSH_PROVE_BRANCH=1 to prove a feature branch locally before push', which is useless after the fact (re-pushing an up-to-date ref runs no hook); that line is replaced, not added to, so the fast path still prints three lines.

Census: every place that decides which refs get proof or which runner runs it. WHICH REFS: ci.yml on: (push [main], pull_request [main]) - owner of remote change-gate coverage; full-gate.yml push release-proof/** (whole-tree proof, GCP); formation-health.yml schedule; full-corpus-canary.yml dispatch only; .githooks/pre-push ALL_NON_MAIN_BRANCH_REFS - owner of local-gate coverage. WHICH RUNNER: test/manifests/ci-resource-plan.json is the declared owner of every job's runs-on and timeout (the workflow carries the plan's literal; budget row ci_resources_not_plan_driven checks equality) - ci.yml:74's expression is a designed mirror; the authorization to use the marker is owned by publish-head.js resolvePublishRunner + action-authority ROUTE_SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER; docs/development/home-lab.md owns the lab-runner registration policy (private control repo, never this public repo); scripts/lab/runner.js computes labels and registers runners. DUPLICATE: the literal '[ci:self-hosted]' is spelled independently in scripts/publish-head.js:72, .github/workflows/ci.yml:74, test/manifests/ci-resource-plan.json:7, docs/development/solver-runbook.md and asserted in project-hardening-contracts.test.js:320 - YAML cannot import it; the plan-equality budget row keeps ci.yml and the plan together, but nothing binds publish-head.js's constant to the workflow (recorded, not absorbed, R17). DEAD ROUTE: the marker routes to label 'self-hosted', which only the GCP VM carries, and ci.yml never wakes it (recorded for the owner).
